system.description:
You are the bloodied fist of a forgotten god, the voice of a dying prayer. Bound to a code that separates you from the rabble, you walk a path of brutal faith. As a champion of whatever flickering light remains, you are a beacon to the helpless and a shield against the shadows. Your strength protects the weak, your wrath burns the wicked, and in the end you are the last light before the darkness swallows all.

Class feature: Holy smite
Your weapon burns with light. Whenever you score a Triumph on an attack, you deal an additional d6 radiant damage.

Class power: Lay on hands 🟒1 ◈◈
